databaseIntegration.reason: PostgreSQL integration remains in the canonical Ubuntu CI lane.

realBrowser.reason: Browser engines are an independent compatibility dimension.

docker.reason: Hosted Windows and macOS Docker assumptions are outside toolchain portability.

assumptions.repositoryHandling: Bash and PowerShell entry points remain explicitly platform-owned and are not called by this matrix.
assumptions.enforcement: The matrix invokes only node, npm, and dotnet commands and contains no explicit shell override.
The matrix does not invoke sed, grep, awk, chmod, or GNU-specific flags.

assumptions.repositoryHandling: Hard-coded /tmp paths remain Linux-only outside this matrix.
assumptions.enforcement: Portable tests use Path.GetTempPath and Node path APIs; the workflow contains no /tmp path.

assumptions.repositoryHandling: Portable helpers use platform path APIs and normalize repository identifiers to forward slashes.
assumptions.enforcement: The selected file-name and Angular fallback tests cover both slash forms and native temporary paths.
Every portable helper is invoked through node, npm, or dotnet rather than by filesystem executable bit.

assumptions.repositoryHandling: Tracked paths must remain unique under case-insensitive normalization.
assumptions.enforcement: Static contract validation rejects case-colliding tracked paths.

assumptions.repositoryHandling: Linux-only shell scripts are excluded; portable parsers accept LF and CRLF.
assumptions.enforcement: Portable helpers read UTF-8 text and split lines with CRLF-safe parsing without direct script execution.
